issue.title: Ledger Tools pill tooltip: "from your private note" for note-derived Event Task fields
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-ji.6 (note #5) as a planned follow-up of epic bob-cli-ji (plan 202611/private_gcal_event_notes.md § Follow-ups); triaged by the bob-cli-ji land agent.

## Proposal
In bob-plugins' Ledger Tools, give the Event Task buffer/root pill a tooltip "from your private note" when the row's `[buffer::]`, `[root::]`, or clock tag came from a private event note. The vault row deliberately carries no provenance glyph (titles can forge glyphs), so the plugin needs a provenance source: bob-cli already journals `gcal.row` records with an additive `note: {hash, fields}` provenance object (hardening phase, commit 7ff24c82). The plugin would read that (or a bob JSON surface exposing it) keyed by block id.

task_type_fields.proposal: Show a 'from your private note' tooltip on Ledger Tools buffer/root pills when gcal.row provenance says a private note contributed that field
